question: How is the second eight-petaled wheel well illuminated?
premises: dvitīyam aṣṭa patram tu is second eight-petaled
teja dhyāna sudīpitam means well illuminated by fire meditation
inference: The second eight-petaled wheel is well illuminated by fire meditation.
uncertainties: whether teja modifies dhyāna or illumination
plain_english: The second eight-petaled wheel is well illuminated by fire meditation.
